optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_ANGELSCRIPT
optionApplicability.reason: AngelScript is experimental and excluded from stable-v1 with G11.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_COLLABORATIVE
optionApplicability.reason: Collaborative service behavior is outside the service-free single-player profile.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_DXR
optionApplicability.reason: DXR belongs to the experimental D3D12 breadth; stable-v1 renders through D3D11.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_HYBRID_RT
optionApplicability.reason: Hybrid ray-tracing breadth is not part of the D3D11 stable-v1 rendering contract.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_LUA
optionApplicability.reason: No scripting runtime is included in stable-v1; scripting work remains outside G11.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_METAL
optionApplicability.reason: Metal and macOS are experimental capabilities outside the Windows D3D11 profile.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_MOBILE
optionApplicability.reason: Mobile hosts are explicitly unsupported by stable-v1.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_NETWORKING
optionApplicability.reason: Constrained LAN is optional, multiplayer is experimental, and neither is required by the single-player profile.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_NEURAL_RENDERING
optionApplicability.reason: Neural rendering is engine-wide experimental breadth and is not required by the D3D11 first-party slice.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_PHYSX
optionApplicability.reason: The alternative PhysX surface is not part of the stable-v1 runtime contract.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_SERVER_PROCESSES
optionApplicability.reason: Dedicated services and production multiplayer are outside the service-free single-player profile.

optionApplicability.name: ENABLE_VR
optionApplicability.reason: VR hosts are explicitly unsupported by stable-v1.

optionApplicability.name: SPARK_DOUBLE_PRECISION_PHYSICS
optionApplicability.reason: Large-world double-precision physics is shared engine breadth, not a requirement of the first stable FPS slice.
